questions.question: What happened to Machiavelli after the Medici retook power in 1512?
options: He was expelled from his diplomatic duties and later sent into exile
He was promoted to a higher government position
He became the head of the Florentine Republic
He was appointed as a cardinal in the church
answer_explanations: Correct. The article says he 'was expelled from his duties as a diplomat when the Medici retook power in Florence in 1512, and soon thereafter would be mistakenly suspected of treason, and sent into exile'.
Incorrect. The opposite happened; he lost his position.

Incorrect. There is no mention of him becoming a cardinal.

questions.question: What did Machiavelli advise rulers to do in *The Prince*?
options: Engage in evil when political necessity requires it
Always follow classical moral teachings
Avoid any form of unsavory policy
Rely primarily on mercenary armies
answer_explanations: Correct. The article says he 'advised rulers to engage in evil when political necessity requires it'.
Incorrect. The article says his advice was 'in contradiction to classical political thought'.
Incorrect. He said rulers 'will have to take on unsavory policies'.
Incorrect. He preferred citizen-soldiers over mercenaries, as stated later in the article.

questions.question: Which work by Machiavelli is said to have paved the way for modern republicanism?
options: *Discourses on Livy*
*The Prince*
*Florentine Histories*
*The Mandrake*
answer_explanations: Correct. The article states that '*Discourses on Livy* ... has been said to have paved the way for modern republicanism'.
Incorrect. *The Prince* is about principalities, not republicanism.
Incorrect. *Florentine Histories* is a history of Florence, not a work on republicanism.
Incorrect. *The Mandrake* is a play, not a political work.

questions.question: What happened to Machiavelli after the Medici returned to power in 1512?
options: He was falsely implicated in a conspiracy and tortured
He was given a high-ranking diplomatic post

questions.question: What did Machiavelli do during his exile at his farm estate?
